name: 19046 · Jenkintown, PA
findings: ZIP 19046 (Jenkintown) has 181 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19046 (Jenkintown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19046 (Jenkintown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
